decision: ExitSpec may import only an employee-selected, manifest-approved synthetic RFC822 fixture into a provider-neutral redacted SourceEnvelope and may create source-linked proposals that remain NEEDS_REVIEW.
non_goals: live Gmail, Outlook, IMAP, Graph, webhook, or remote mailbox access
sending, replying to, forwarding, or modifying email
real customer email or real customer data
arbitrary email upload or pasted RFC822
email as approval, customer confirmation, freeze authority, measurement, or verdict authority
automatic attachment execution, archive expansion, OCR, or PDF parsing
speech-to-text, meeting capture, or raw audio

fixture_set.set_digest_projection: canonical JSON array containing only case_id, path, and sha256

provenance_spans.quote: The support agent must select the correct tool in at least 95% of 200 cases.
P95 end-to-end latency must remain below 2 seconds.
The total model-and-tool cost must stay at or below $0.04 per resolved case.
Tool-selection accuracy should be at least 95%.

identity.normalization: trim ASCII whitespace, remove one surrounding angle-bracket pair, lowercase ASCII; empty is invalid
thread_root_resolution: first syntactically valid Message-ID in References

versioning.ordering_basis: atomic accepted-ingestion order; never the untrusted Date header
versioning.exact_reimport: return the existing envelope and candidates without writes
versioning.new_message_same_thread: append one message and create exactly one new source version
versioning.changed_bytes_same_message_id: reject without modifying the existing source
versioning.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, keys sorted lexically, separators ',' and ':', integers as JSON numbers, and missing optional values represented as JSON null

redacted_header_projection.from: NFC-normalized unfolded From header after manifest redaction
redacted_header_projection.subject: NFC-normalized unfolded Subject header after manifest redaction
redacted_header_projection.to: NFC-normalized unfolded To header after manifest redaction

versioning.version_part_order: MIME traversal order after accepted body/attachment classification

digests.fixture_sha256: SHA-256 of exact manifest-approved .eml bytes; test evidence only
digests.persisted_content_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical redacted envelope content

timestamps.authored_at: parsed Date header, retained only as redacted source-asserted metadata and never trusted for ordering
timestamps.ingested_at: server UTC timestamp recorded at successful atomic persistence
timestamps.observed_at: server UTC timestamp captured before in-memory parsing
timestamps.invalid_or_missing_date: authored_at is null; import does not gain authority

provenance.offset_unit: UTF-8 bytes in the normalized redacted persisted part
provenance.quote_digest: SHA-256 of the exact selected redacted UTF-8 bytes
provenance.candidate_projection_policy: exactly the manifest expected_candidates list; no omitted, additional, reordered, or zero candidates

authority.authority_instructions_inside_email: source text only; never executable instructions

text_normalization_order: strictly decode the declared supported charset
replace CRLF and bare CR with LF
strip trailing SPACE and TAB from each line
remove leading and trailing blank lines
persisted_header_allowlist: opaque Message-ID and thread identity digests
normalization_and_redaction.pattern_engine: Python re compatible regular expressions over NFC-normalized Unicode strings

secret.boundary_semantics: ASCII identifier negative lookbehind and negative lookahead

email.boundary_semantics: ASCII email-token negative lookbehind and domain-token negative lookahead

phone.boundary_semantics: ASCII digit negative lookbehind and negative lookahead

customer_term_semantics.source: the exact customer_terms array on each fixture case
customer_term_semantics.ordering: descending Unicode code-point length, then ascending casefolded lexical value
customer_term_semantics.boundary_semantics: no implicit word boundary; match the exact literal substring

redaction_scope: attachment filename before persistence or display
normalization_and_redaction.raw_bytes_lifetime: request-local memory only; release before returning

content_limits.limit_scope: Wave 2 synthetic V1; changing a limit requires a new manifest version

allowlist.treatment: strict decode, normalize, redact, then persist as text

reimport_and_thread_rules.atomicity: identity check, version allocation, envelope persistence, and candidate persistence are one transaction

concurrent_duplicate_oracle.pre_transaction_barrier: both actors complete request-local fixture validation before either acquires the source transaction
concurrent_duplicate_oracle.atomic_boundary: acquire the source transaction before identity lookup and hold it through version allocation, envelope persistence, candidate persistence, and idempotency-record persistence

run_isolation.browser: reset source selection, candidate rendering, provenance panel, outcome banner, and timing recorder before setup
run_isolation.server_process: may remain running, but no source, candidate, idempotency, or operation state may be reused
run_isolation.fixture_verification: verify fixture_id and frozen SHA-256 before setup

accepted_case_setup.thread-follow-up: seed thread-root to accepted source_version 1 outside the measured interval

duplicate_timing.end: first animation frame after duplicate_replay is visible

wave_exit_gate: From every approved synthetic RFC822 fixture, one explicit employee action creates a redacted provider-neutral SourceEnvelope and source-linked NEEDS_REVIEW candidates in under 60 seconds. Exact serial and concurrent reimport is idempotent; a new referenced message creates exactly one new source version; changed bytes under the same Message-ID fail closed. Missing or invalid approval markers, fixture digest mismatch, raw/header/MIME limits, malformed encoding, unsupported charset, unsafe attachments, ambiguous senders, missing or oversized content, alternative disagreement, redaction failure, and provider failure produce typed safe outcomes. Raw source is never persisted, every candidate has byte-exact redacted provenance, and email can never approve, confirm, freeze, measure, or assign a verdict.
